decisions.headline: IGN：Rockstar 新 Mod 规范禁止未经授权的商业化，GTA RP 服务器不得自行引入真钱交易
decisions.summary: IGN 报道称，Rockstar 网站列出的 Mod 规则明确禁止未经授权的商业化，包括在 Mod 中使用加密货币或传统货币进行真钱交易、真钱赌博以及第三方赞助内容。报道据此认为，未经 Rockstar 授权的未来 GTA RP 服务器无法自行建立这类商业化体系。
decisions.verification: 当前 packet 仅打开 IGN 二手报道；正文只按 IGN 对 Rockstar 网站政策的转述收录，不把 IGN 对未来 GTA 6 RP 生态的推断写成官方结论。
decisions.reason: 窗口内报道提供明确政策信息增量，且可在单一媒体报道边界内安全收录。
decisions.timeNote: IGN 页面发布时间换算为北京时间9月22日02:43，位于本期固定窗口内。

entries.headline: IGN: Rockstar’s Modding Policy Bars Unauthorized Commercialization on GTA RP Servers
entries.summary: IGN reports that Rockstar’s published modding rules prohibit unauthorized commercialization, including real-money transactions through crypto or traditional currency, real-money gambling, and third-party sponsored content. IGN interprets the rules as limiting independently monetized future GTA RP servers unless Rockstar authorizes them.
entries.verification: Only IGN is opened in the packet. The entry is framed as IGN’s report of Rockstar’s website policy and does not elevate IGN’s interpretation of future GTA 6 RP servers into an official conclusion.
entries.timeNote: IGN’s publication time converts to September 22 at 02:43 Beijing time, inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: The Blood of Dawnwalker’s First Major Update Will Add an Easier Difficulty in October
entries.summary: IGN relays a Eurogamer interview with Rebel Wolves game director Konrad Tomaszkiewicz saying the game’s first major update, planned for early October, will add a difficulty below the current Story Mode. The current easiest mode will be renamed, bringing the total to five difficulty settings.
entries.verification: The packet opens IGN’s report, which relays the Eurogamer interview. No exact update date or details beyond the opened report are added.
entries.timeNote: IGN’s publication time converts to September 22 at 07:53 Beijing time. The update is only described as arriving in early October.

entries.headline: Blighted Delayed to 2027 as DrinkBox Says It Needs More Polish
entries.summary: Gematsu reports that DrinkBox Studios has moved Blighted from its previously planned fall 2026 window to 2027 for Nintendo Switch 2 and PC via Steam. The studio also plans one more developer update before the end of 2026.
entries.verification: Gematsu directly relays DrinkBox Studios’ developer blog and a statement from Josh Davis. The primary blog page is not opened in this packet, so the item is labeled as a media relay of official information.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu’s publication time converts to September 21 at 22:14 Beijing time.

entries.headline: Minecraft LIVE Set for September 27 at 2:00 a.m. JST
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Mojang Studios has announced a new Minecraft LIVE broadcast for September 27 at 2:00 a.m. Japan time. The announcement video uses the phrase “The next chapter for Minecraft,” but this entry does not infer any specific reveal beyond that wording.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON explicitly relays Mojang Studios’ broadcast announcement. The primary Mojang page is not opened in the packet, so the item is labeled as a media relay of official information.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON’s publication time converts to September 22 at 06:10 Beijing time; the broadcast is scheduled for September 27 at 02:00 JST.

entries.headline: MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA Details Act Mode and an Approximately 20-Hour Grand Scenario Mode
entries.summary: AUTOMATON’s hands-on and media-session report says MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA adds Act Mode with one-button special moves, dashes, and mash combos. Its Grand Scenario Mode features a scenario written by Kinoko Nasu and was described at the media session as roughly 20 hours long.
entries.verification: The gameplay details and estimated scenario length come directly from AUTOMATON’s opened TGS 2026 hands-on and media-session report.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON’s publication time converts to September 21 at 14:18 Beijing time.

entries.headline: IGN: Blizzard Says Its 2030 StarCraft Shooter Will Not Be Xbox-Exclusive
entries.summary: IGN relays Kotaku’s email exchange with Blizzard representatives saying the open-world StarCraft shooter planned for 2030 will not be exclusive to Xbox. Blizzard has not clarified whether that means other consoles, a PC release, or both; an Xbox console version is currently the only specific platform referenced in the opened report.
entries.verification: Only IGN is opened in the packet, and the key statement is itself relayed from Kotaku’s exchange with Blizzard. The non-exclusivity claim is kept within that media-report boundary, while additional platforms remain unconfirmed.
entries.timeNote: IGN’s publication time converts to September 22 at 04:45 Beijing time; 2030 is the release year stated in the report.

entries.headline: Bungie Says Marathon Will Evolve Into a Deeper Survival Experience
entries.summary: IGN relays a September 21 video message from Bungie studio head Poria Torkan and Marathon product lead Josh Dean saying the team plans to move beyond its current genre constraints and develop Marathon into a deeper survival experience, with more player agency across PvE and PvP by the end of year one.
entries.verification: IGN directly relays statements from Bungie’s official video message. The video and blog are not opened in the packet, so the item is labeled as a media relay of official information.
entries.timeNote: IGN’s publication time converts to September 22 at 00:26 Beijing time; the relayed video message is dated September 21.
